CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.can_read_data_group(p_group_id bigint, p_staff_id bigint, p_organization_id bigint)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT private.group_access('data',p_group_id,p_staff_id,p_organization_id) IS NOT NULL;
$function$
identity_args: p_group_id bigint, p_staff_id bigint, p_organization_id bigint
name: can_read_data_group
